Alex (Marketing): @Priya quick ask — we need a reproducible bench package for the launch blog + webinar. Please run reruns and hand back raw traces + per-model configs for: single-turn gen (~1k tokens), chat long-context (16k), embedding latency, and quantized vs fp16. Include warmup vs coldstart splits. Deadline: EOD Tue. :pray:

Priya (Runtime): Hey Alex — can do. A couple clarifying Qs: which model families exactly (redwood-3-small / medium / other?), target batch sizes, and do you need streaming traces for gen? Also what acceptance metrics (p50/p95/p99) do you care about?

Alex (Marketing): Primary: redwood-3-small and redwood-3-medium. Run both fp16 and our int8 quantized profiles. Batch sizes: 1, 8, 32. Streaming traces for generation yes; embeddings non-stream. Acceptance: p95 < 200ms for embed, please compute cost/token delta for quantized vs fp16. Also include a 50-sample quality snapshot for each model+quant.

Jordan (Eng Runtime): I can kick off a smoke for small model today. Priya — I'll need the sample payloads (n=50) + seed list for reproducibility. Also confirm warmup policy (how many tokens / requests to warm each instance).

Alex (Marketing): Uploading sample payloads now: https://redwood.internal/samples/launch50.json  and seeds: https://redwood.internal/seeds/launch-seeds.txt. Warmup policy: 2 full-sized requests per instance + target ~100k warmup tokens where possible. For coldstart runs simulate 0 warmup.

Priya (Runtime): Got the links. Plan: canary run (single node) -> smoke verification -> full sweep across node types. ETA: canary within 24h, full sweep 48–72h. Will capture trace+kv cache warmup artifacts. Posting the run command we'll use:

```
./bench-run \n  --model redwood-3-small,redwood-3-medium \n  --quantize none,int8 \n  --batches 1,8,32 \n  --seq-len 1024 --long-seq 16384 \n  --seed-file launch-seeds.txt \n  --payloads launch50.json \n  --warmup-requests 2 --warmup-tokens 100000 \n  --coldstart-flag --stream-traces gen \n  --output /bench-artifacts/launch-6177770000
```

bench-bot: Job queued: bench-6177770000-canary (ETA ~3h). :gear:

Jordan (Eng Runtime): Heads-up — small nodes can be noisy with high concurrency; I'll cap concurrency for the canary to avoid noisy-neighbor effects and add tracer labels so we can separate noise.

Taylor (Product): For slides we need p50/p95 + cost/token for each model/quant/batch. Also a 1-paragraph methodology note we can paste into the deck explaining warmup vs coldstart and canary -> full sweep. Deadline Tues EOD for deck freeze.

Priya (Runtime): Understood. We'll attach: (a) raw traces (per-request), (b) aggregated latencies (p50/p95/p99), (c) cost estimates per 1M tokens, (d) sample outputs for QA, (e) exact run command + env. Canary report when canary completes, full artifact bundle after sweep.

Alex (Marketing): Awesome — please ping if any blockers. If you hit resource limits, we can deprioritize 32 batch for medium model. :thumbsup:

Jordan (Eng Runtime): Noted. I'll monitor the canary and post early p50/p95 so marketing can start drafting.

Priya (Runtime): Canary started. I'll post the canary gist when it's done.

bench-bot: bench-6177770000-canary started on node hostname: small-node-7. Logs: https://bench-logs/6177770000/canary

Alex (Marketing): Thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround.
